en.hubeali:
And by this chain, said, 
‘A man from the helpers complained to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> that the houses had congested him.
So the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Raise your voice as much as you can and ask Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> Makes it spacious for you’.
en.sarwar: 8. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “Once, a man of the people of al-Ansar complained before the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, that houses have caused great congestions for him.
The Holy Prophet said to him, ‘Raise your voice as much as you can and ask Allah to make it spacious for you.’”
